items.name: Calgary Spring 2026
items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Temecula Valley Spring 2026
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TemeculaValleySpring2026#66928-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com):
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbnAvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--15a5362b7dafef77d8a7208815366d5958ab4162/scswcc.png)

items.name: Marietta the Gathering 2026

venue.name: Glover Park
venue.details: East Park Square (3x3 Round 1 and 2 - Southeast Cubing Booth, 3x3 Round 3 - Stage)

items.information:
This competition is a part of [Marietta the Gathering](https://www.mariettaga.gov/1480/Marietta-the-Gathering), a free outdoor festival celebrating pop culture, nerd/geek community, and the arts. All elements of the competition will be outdoors and subject to delay/cancellation in the case of inclement weather. 

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MariettatheGathering2026#66271-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
